subject: Follow-up: Next steps & rotating demo windows
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elena Costa <elena@medicore.com>, Tim Jones <tim.jones@medicore.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Next steps & rotating demo windows

Hi Elena / Tim —

Thanks again for carving out time today — appreciated the candid look at your evaluation criteria and the latency/cost targets you gave us. Quick recap of what I heard:
- Primary goals: reduce inference cost for batch reporting, improve tail latency for interactive clinician queries, and keep data on customer-managed infrastructure for PHI-sensitive flows.
- Must-haves for any pilot: SOC 2 evidence, a predictable SLA for p95 responses, and a plan for rolling model updates without downtime.

Next step: we proposed a technical deep dive (90 minutes) with your infra and security leads. Given your teams in EU/US/APAC, we usually run a rotating 3-week window so each region gets at least one friendly-time slot without forcing extreme hours. Below I sketched a simple rotation we can operate as a pilot — we can tweak cadence: 1) US-morning/Europe-late-afternoon, 2) Europe-morning/APAC-evening, 3) APAC-morning/US-evening.

Concrete slots I can offer next two weeks (all times shown with common mappings):
- Option A (Week 1, US-friendly): Tue 9:00 AM PDT / Tue 6:00 PM CEST / Wed 1:00 AM SGT
- Option B (Week 2, EU-friendly): Wed 8:00 AM CEST / Wed 10:00 PM PDT / Thu 3:00 PM SGT
- Option C (Week 3, APAC-friendly): Thu 9:30 AM SGT / Thu 5:30 PM CEST / Thu 8:30 PM PDT

If you prefer, we can put a repeating calendar entry that rotates every week (we'll own the technical facilitator and the recording). Please tell me: 1) which of the three options looks closest to your team's availability, 2) any hard time blackout windows for infra/security people, and 3) whether you want us to include an initial agenda (recommended: infra topology, data flow + keys, perf targets, fallback plan).

I've attached a draft SOW for pilot scoping and a sample .ics that demonstrates the rotation pattern.

Thanks — I can be flexible on the day if that helps.

Mina Haddad
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments: Medicore_SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf), rolling-demo-rotation.ics (text/calendar)

Subject: Re: Follow-up: Next steps & rotating demo windows

Hi Mina —

Thanks for the thorough recap. Short replies to your asks:
1) We definitely need SOC 2 evidence and the short list of endpoints that would store PHI in the private deployment.
2) For scheduling: our infra/security folks (based in Madrid and London) prefer morning CEST slots if possible. Late EU afternoons are tricky because UK/ES overlaps with end-of-day reviews.
3) Blackouts: Fri afternoons CEST (weekly maintenance) and Mondays before 11:00 CEST.

Of your options, Option B (EU-friendly) is closest but can we move it an hour earlier so it's 07:30 CEST? That helps the Madrid team join before daily syncs. Tim can take the APAC overlap on recordings.

Also: Tim and I would appreciate a short pre-read (1 pager) describing exactly what you'll demo from a network/configuration perspective (ports, egress, key management).

Best,
Elena Costa
VP IT Operations | Medicore Health
elena@medicore.com

--
